summary.name: VLC media player
summary.one_liner: VLC is a free, open source, cross-platform multimedia player and framework from the non-profit VideoLAN project that plays most media files and streaming protocols.
keywords: free alternative to paid media players
use_cases: play local video and audio files
play DVDs, Blu-ray and audio CDs
free replacement for commercial media players
summary.what_it_does: VLC is a free and open source cross-platform multimedia player and framework that plays most multimedia files, DVDs, Audio CDs, VCDs and various streaming protocols. The page lists a current version 3.0.24 for Windows and links to news about related VideoLAN libraries, including libbluray, libaacs, libdvdcss, libdvdread and the dav1d AV1 decoder. VideoLAN also announced dav2d, a decoder for the AV2 codec, in early development. The project is funded by user donations and is developed as open-source software that accepts contributions.
notable: Free, open source, non-profit project funded by donations
Plays DVDs, Audio CDs, VCDs and many streaming protocols
Maintains related codec libraries such as dav1d (AV1) and dav2d (AV2)
Version 3.0.24 security update with over 130 security fixes
caveats: Page text lists only Windows as a platform for the current download; other platforms are not detailed on this page
dav2d is described as early work with limited feature set
